target.title: feat(browser): support GPT-5.6 Sol and update Oracle skill
target.body:
## Summary

- Add first-class browser-only `gpt-5.6` and `gpt-5.6-sol` aliases for ChatGPT's GPT-5.6 Sol picker entry.
- Support GPT-5.6's unified Intelligence picker, including current English/Chinese effort labels and React-replaced composer pills.
- Update `skills/oracle/SKILL.md` with the GPT-5.6 workflow, Pro/base-Sol distinction, rollout-aware fallback, compatibility guidance, and model-selection evidence requirements.

This is an integration PR for the two implementation PRs below plus a revised version of the documentation work in #311.

## Reference PRs and differences

### [#306 — feat(browser): add GPT-5.6 Sol model aliases](https://github.com/steipete/oracle/pull/306)

PR #306 adds the CLI/model-routing layer:

- browser-only `gpt-5.6` and `gpt-5.6-sol` aliases
- navigation through the current GPT-5.x version submenu
- strict verification that the selected inner radio is actually GPT-5.6 Sol
- rejection of unknown future variants instead of silent fallback
- rejection of bare GPT-5.6 aliases in API and multi-model paths

### [#304 — fix(browser): support GPT-5.6 unified effort picker](https://github.com/steipete/oracle/pull/304)

PR #304 fixes the browser interaction layer:

- detection of the wrapped `composer-intelligence-picker-content` menu
- mapping of the unified `Pro` row and current Chinese labels
- collision-safe matching so `高` cannot win over `极高`
- re-querying the composer pill after React replaces the clicked node

### [#311 — docs: update Oracle skill for GPT-5.6 Sol Pro](https://github.com/steipete/oracle/pull/311)

PR #311 updates the documentation to recommend the newer Pro workflow. This PR
keeps that useful distinction, but adjusts it in two ways:

- Pro is documented as a separate picker target rather than as the explicit
  `GPT-5.6 Sol Pro` alias, because #306 intentionally accepts only the bare
  GPT-5.6 family and explicit Sol aliases.
- The documentation now qualifies the gradual rollout and states that a bare
  `Pro` picker result proves picker selection but not the server-side Pro
  generation.

## Why this integration is preferable

The reference PRs solve complementary layers of the same problem. Combining
them gives end-to-end behavior: the CLI can request GPT-5.6 Sol, the browser
can navigate the new picker, and the result is verified against the actual
selected model and effort level. The documentation also prevents the old npm
0.15.2 behavior from being mistaken for GPT-5.6: that release can normalize
`gpt-5.6*` labels to `gpt-5.2`.

The integrated behavior is deliberately fail-closed:

- API and multi-model calls reject bare GPT-5.6 aliases because they are
  browser-only in this release.
- Unknown variants such as `gpt-5.6-luna` do not silently select Sol.
- A stale, detached composer pill cannot be used as successful selection
  evidence.
- Accounts without the GPT-5.6 rollout have an explicit `gpt-5.5-pro`
  fallback and are not told that the fallback is GPT-5.6.

## Validation

- `pnpm check`
- `pnpm vitest run`: 1,521 passed, 43 skipped across 162 files
- Focused model-selection/thinking-time/CLI tests: 245 passed
- `uv run --with pyyaml .../quick_validate.py skills/oracle`: valid
- Dry-run confirmed `gpt-5.6` and `gpt-5.6-sol` remain browser targets, API and
  multi-model calls are rejected, and `gpt-5.6-luna` is rejected.
- Browser smoke confirmed:
  - `GPT-5.6 Sol` with `Extra High`, strict selection evidence, and a successful
    response marker
  - independent `Pro` selection without a thinking-time flag and a successful
    response marker

The branch is based on the common base of #304 and #306 and is intended to be
reviewed as a combined integration. No upstream branch was modified directly.

## Summary

- add browser-only `gpt-5.6` and `gpt-5.6-sol` aliases, both currently targeting ChatGPT's `GPT-5.6 Sol` entry
- keep the generic and pinned aliases distinct so the generic mapping can move when ChatGPT introduces a new default

- keep verified version evidence authoritative when the localized composer pill only shows an effort such as `极速`; missing or effort-only labels cannot self-verify as GPT-5.6 Sol
- report `switched` when a target row becomes checked after a click even if React leaves the localized effort pill unchanged
- reject bare GPT-5.6 aliases in API/multi-model paths while preserving provider-qualified custom-id passthrough
- keep unknown future variants such as `gpt-5.6-luna` from silently falling back to Sol

Fixes #305.

This complements #304: that PR fixes the unified effort picker, while this PR adds first-class GPT-5.6 version routing and strict model-selection evidence.

## Tests

- `pnpm vitest run tests/browser/modelSelection.test.ts tests/cli/options.test.ts tests/cli/browserConfig.test.ts tests/runOptions.test.ts tests/cli/integrationCli.test.ts` (250 passed)
- `pnpm check`
- `env -u ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pnpm vitest run --exclude tests/browser/profileCopy.test.ts` (142 files / 1,430 tests passed; the excluded test requires system `rsync`, which is not installed in this environment)
- browser API fail-fast smoke exits 1 with `GPT-5.6 Sol is browser-only today`

## Live browser validation

Validated through signed-in ChatGPT Pro AdsPower profiles:

- English (US):
  - `--model gpt-5.6` returned `ORACLE_GPT56_EN_ALIAS_OK`
  - `--model gpt-5.6-sol` returned `ORACLE_GPT56_EN_SOL_OK`
- Chinese UI, with this PR combined temporarily with #304:
  - `--model gpt-5.6 --browser-thinking-time extended` returned `ORACLE_GPT56_ZH_EVIDENCE_FIXED_OK`
  - model evidence is now `requested=GPT-5.6 Sol; resolved=GPT-5.6 Sol; verified=yes`
  - the effort was independently confirmed as `Thinking time: 高 (already selected)`

No live test clicked or auto-clicked ChatGPT's "Answer now" control.

target.title: fix(browser): support GPT-5.6 unified effort picker
target.body:
## Summary

- recognize GPT-5.6's outer effort menu when it wraps `composer-intelligence-picker-content`
- map the legacy Pro Extended request to the unified picker's checked `Pro` radio only when the legacy Pro effort trigger is absent, preserving the older nested path and fail-closed behavior
- select the current Chinese Intelligence labels exactly: `light -> 极速5.5`, `standard -> 中`, `extended -> 高`, and `heavy -> 极高`, without matching `高` inside `极高`
- preserve older Chinese layouts by accepting bare `高` for `heavy` only as a second-pass fallback when no primary heavy label is present
- re-query a composer effort pill after React replaces the clicked node, so a successful switch is verified instead of reported as `selection-unverified`
- treat GPT-5.6 as a versioned Intelligence target so a current `Pro` pill does not force ordinary effort requests into Pro semantics; unrelated composer pills such as Canvas remain excluded

Fixes #303.

## Root cause

The GPT-5.6 UI moved effort radios into a wrapped unified Intelligence menu, renamed the top effort to `Pro`, and replaces the composer pill after a selection. The previous selector only recognized the inner menu, expected the legacy Pro submenu, used older Chinese aliases, and verified against the detached pre-click pill.

## Tests

- `pnpm vitest run tests/browser/thinkingTime.test.ts` (27 passed)
- `pnpm check`
- `env -u ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pnpm vitest run --exclude tests/browser/profileCopy.test.ts` (142 files / 1,415 tests passed; the excluded test requires system `rsync`, which is not installed in this environment)
- live browser smoke on both configured signed-in ChatGPT Pro profiles through local AdsPower
  - both profiles still confirm the unified `Pro` path and submit successfully
  - Chinese UI: `light -> 极速5.5`, `standard -> 中`, `extended -> 高`, and `heavy -> 极高`
  - all four runs submitted and returned their exact smoke markers; the post-selection runs no longer report `selection-unverified`
  - combined with #306, `--model gpt-5.6 --browser-thinking-time extended` recorded `resolved=GPT-5.6 Sol`, confirmed `Thinking time: 高`, and returned `ORACLE_GPT56_ZH_EVIDENCE_FIXED_OK`

## Inspectable live-browser evidence

Validated against commit `19a57b158575599f8a4e2af4271a33f50bbf9e33`.
